column1: 22169§involve§ɪnˈvɒlv§vt. 使卷入，使参与；牵涉，陷入，连累；包含，含有§No city can be simply a port but must be involved in a variety of other activities.§没有哪个城市能够单纯作为港口，它必然还含有其他多种功能。
22170§dairy§ˈdeəri§n. 奶制品；乳品店 adj. 乳制品的§Try using low-lactose dairy foods, such as yogurt, instead of milk.§尝试用一些低乳的奶制品，如酸奶，来代替牛奶。
22171§confirm§kənˈfɜːm§vt. 证实，确定；肯定；批准，使有效§If a prediction based on a hypothesis is fulfilled，then the hypothesis is confirmed.§如果基于某一假设的预测得到实现，那么该假设就被证实是正确的。
22172§hinge§hɪndʒ§n. 合叶；铰链 v. 依…而定§The two metal tubes joined at a hinge at one end.§这两根金属管的末端连接在一个铰链上。
22173§subsidise§ˈsʌbsɪdaɪz§vt. 津贴，资助§They actually subsidise the exploitation and consumption of natural resources.§他们实际上为自然资源的开发和消费提供资助。
22174§stain§steɪn§vt. （被）玷污；给…着色 n. 污点，污渍§The ink stained his shirt blue.§墨水给他的衬衫染上了蓝色。
22175§unload§ˌʌnˈləʊd§v. 从…卸下货物；摆脱§Loading and unloading costs can be minimised by refining raw materials or turning them into finished goods.§可以通过对原材料进行加工或将其制成成品来将它们的装卸成本降至最低。
22176§conversion§kənˈvɜːʃn§n. 转化；转变，变换；兑换；改变信仰，皈依§Clean coal is another avenue for improving fuel conversion efficiency.§洁净煤是提高燃烧转换效率的另一种途径。
22177§irrelevant§ɪˈreləvənt§adj. 不相关的；离题的§What you wrote is almost irrelevant to the topic.§你写的文章和主题几乎无关。
22178§thrill§θrɪl§v. （使）非常激动；（使）发抖§The traveller thrilled us with his stories of adventure.§这位旅行者的冒险经历令我们激动不已。
22179§trial§ˈtraɪəl§n. 审讯；试验 adj. 试验性的 v. （全面彻底地）测试，试验，试用§The trial lasted for three days.§审讯持续了三天。
22180§extol§ɪkˈstəʊl§vt. 赞颂，赞美，颂扬§Weld extolled Kerry's debate skills, saying he has “the speed of a welter-weight.”§韦尔德称赞了克里的辩论技巧，说他有着“次中量级拳击手的速度”。
22181§albeit§ˌɔːlˈbiːɪt§conj. 虽然，尽管§A program for low-carbon energy finally got through this month, albeit in substantially scaled-down form.§一项低碳能源的计划本月最终获得通过，尽管其规模大大缩小。
22182§obstacle§ˈɒbstəkl§n. 障碍，妨碍物，干扰§An obstacle, setback or delay means only one thing: it's not time for your goal to be completed yet.§一个障碍、挫败或延迟只意味着一件事：现在还不是你实现目标的时候。
22183§meagre§ˈmiːgə(r)§adj. 少量且劣质的§His meagre salary couldn't afford the basic consumption in the time of inflation.§通货膨胀期间，他那点可怜巴巴的工资不足以维持最基本的开销。

22184§precipitation§prɪˌsɪpɪˈteɪʃn§n. 降雨（量），降水（量）；【化】沉淀作用§According to the statistic released by the Office of State Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters, precipitation in many parts of central China has been 50 to 80 percent above normal.§国家防汛抗旱总指挥部办公室公布的数据显示，华中很多地区的降水量比同期正常水平高了50%~80%。
22185§precarious§prɪˈkeəriəs§adj. 不安全的，充满危险的；不牢靠的，不稳固的§The peninsula's peace will face a precarious situation if the negotiation breaks down.§如果谈判破裂，半岛的和平将面临岌岌可危的局面。
22186§autonomy§ɔːˈtɒnəmi§n. 自治，自治权；自主权§Each of the area managers enjoys considerable autonomy in the running of his own area.§每一位地区经理在各自主管的区域都享有相当大的自主权。

22187§credibility§ˌkredəˈbɪləti§n. 可信性，可靠性§Credibility is an essential characteristic that is built on the elements of integrity, reliability, veracity, competence and commitment.§诚信是一个重要的品质，是建立在正直、可靠、诚实、能力和承诺的基础之上的。
22188§onslaught§ˈɒnslɔːt§n. 猛攻，猛袭§The onslaught of media attention has brought unnecessary distraction to the boxer who should focus exclusively on his competition.§媒体的过分关注使这个拳击手很分心，他本应该只专注于比赛的。
22189§curtail§kɜːˈteɪl§vt. 缩短，削减；剥夺§The new constitution imposed a dogmatic property rules which had severely curtailed people's interest.§新宪法强制推行专断财产法，严重损害了民众利益。
22190§correlation§ˌkɒrəˈleɪʃn§n. 相互关系，相关（性）§There's a high correlation between trace element selenium insufficient and functional disease.§微量元素硒不足和官能性疾病有着紧密的联系。
22191§afflicting§əˈflɪktɪŋ§adj. 痛苦的§Violent crime is only one of the maladies afflicting modern society.§暴力犯罪仅仅是困扰现代社会的严重问题之一。
22192§simulation§ˌsɪmjuˈleɪʃn§n. 假装；模拟§The manager was beforehand with a computer simulation of likely sales performance in advance of the Spring Festival.§经理在春节来临前就事先用计算机模拟出了可能的销售业绩。

22193§incongruous§ɪnˈkɒŋɡruəs§adj. 不协调的，不一致的；不适宜的§As incongruous as it may sound, the little frog with big eyes has no lungs and gets all the oxygen it needs through its skin.§听起来可能不可思议的是，这种身材小巧、眼睛大大的蛙类居然没有肺，所需氧气均要靠皮肤来获得。

22194§remuneration§rɪˌmjuːnəˈreɪʃn§n. 报酬；薪水§To meet the requirements of public interest, the investment of the investors could be expropriated in comply with legal procedure with a due remuneration.§为了满足公共利益的需求，可以依照法律程序没收投资者的投资，并给予相应的报酬。

22195§intermix§ˌɪntəˈmɪks§v. 混入，混杂§In an insignificant basis of reality, the imagination spins, weaving new patterns and intermixing with memories, experience, free fancies, incongruities and improvisations.§在微不足道的现实中，想象力织就着新的世界，混合着记忆、经历、自由幻想、怪异及随想。

22196§paramount§ˈpærəmaʊnt§adj. 最重要的，决定性的§We believed that it is of paramount importance to disseminate knowledge, so that patient care will continue to improve across the Europe and beyond.§我们相信传播知识是最重要的，以使欧洲及其他地方的患者护理得到持续改善。
22197§hypnotic§hɪpˈnɒtɪk§adj. 催眠的 n. 催眠药§Western people believed that being hypnotic could help people remember something happening in life.§西方人相信，催眠可以帮助人们记起生活中发生的一些事。
22198§suffice§səˈfaɪs§v. 足够，足以；满足…的需求§No more boring lectures, painful seminars or tiring presentations. A few sentences will suffice.§没有枯燥的说教、痛苦的研讨会或令人厌倦的演讲，几句话就够了。
22199§technician§tekˈnɪʃn§n. 技术员，技师§This looseness in molecular structure of glass allows technicians to tailor it to whatever they need.§玻璃松散的分子结构使技术人员可以按照自己的需求对其进行加工。
22200§apart§əˈpɑːt§adv. 相间隔；分离；除去 adj. 分离的§Apart from the Second World War period, the Winter Olympics were held every four years.§除了第二次世界大战期间，冬奥会每四年举行一次。
22201§mainstream§ˈmeɪnstriːm§n. 主要倾向，主要趋势，主流§His radical views place him outside the mainstream of American politics.§他的激进观点使他脱离了美国政治的主流。
22202§flush§flʌʃ§v. 冲洗，清除；（使）发红；（使）脸红；奔流 n. 脸红 adj. 齐平的，同高的§You can flush a wound with iodine to prevent the infection.§可以用碘酒冲洗伤口，以防止感染。
22203§stir§stɜː(r)§v./n. 搅动；摇动；激动§You'd better give the coffee a stir before you drink it.§喝咖啡之前最好先搅拌一下。
22204§odd§ɒd§adj. 奇特的；偶尔出现的；奇数的§We are attracted by the odd behavior of the boy.§男孩古怪的行为吸引了我们。

22205§inject§ɪnˈdʒekt§vt. 注射；注入，灌输§By injecting lime into the land around the water and neutralizing the effects of acid, scientists have created conditions in which fish can survive.§通过对水域周围的土地注入石灰，中和当地的酸性效应，科学家已经创造出能让鱼存活的环境。
22206§demand§dɪˈmɑːnd§n. 要求；需求（量） v. 要求；需要；询问§Tall buildings were constructed to help meet the demand for more economical use of land.§高层建筑的建造是为了满足节约用地的需求。
22207§unsatisfactory§ˌʌnˌsætɪsˈfæktəri§adj. 不能令人满意的§Reception of television programmes is unsatisfactory here.§这个地区电视节目的接收情况不能令人满意。
22208§excursion§ɪkˈskɜːʃn§n. 远足，短途旅游；【物】偏移，漂移§Our family took a two-week excursion to France.§我们一家人去法国旅行了两周。
22209§grid§grɪd§n. 格子，栅格；地图上的坐标方格；输电网；煤气输送网§New York is laid out on a grid, which makes it easier to find your way around.§纽约市的布局十分整齐，因此你不容易迷路。
22210§controversial§ˌkɒntrəˈvɜːʃl§adj. 争论的§The appearance of individual buildings is often controversial.§私人建筑的外观常常会引起争议。
22211§wagon§ˈwægən§n. 四轮马车；货车；（铁路）货车车厢，车皮§The horses were harnessed and hooked to the wagon.§这些马被装上挽具，套到马车上。
22212§reputation§ˌrepjuˈteɪʃn§n. 名誉，名声§The college has already established a national reputation for its excellence.§该校凭借着自己的卓越表现已经享誉全国。
22213§tag§tæg§n. 标签；附加语 v. 跟随；给…加标签；添加§If you are going to see the film, would you mind if I tag along?§你要是去看电影，我也跟着去行吗？
22214§dizzy§ˈdɪzi§adj. 头晕目眩的，眩晕的；（使人）头晕的§He is dizzy and confused and does not want to be here.§他感到眩晕迷惑，不想待在这儿。
22215§immune§ɪˈmjuːn§adj. 免疫的，有免疫力的；有抵抗力的；不受影响的；免除的，免除惩罚的，豁免的§The viruses stimulated the immune system.§病毒刺激了免疫系统。
22216§carve§kɑːv§v. 切；雕刻§§
22217§geology§dʒiˈɒlədʒi§n. 地质学；地质概况§The geology varies a good deal from region to region even in one country.§即使是在同一个国家，不同地区的地况也极为不同。
22218§directory§dəˈrektəri§n. 人名地址录；电话号码簿§For our addresses, just check in your local telephone directory.§你可以在当地的电话簿中找到我们的地址。
22219§vital§ˈvaɪtl§adj. 生死攸关的；极其重要的；有生命力的§The Department has a vital role to play in providing information to visitors and scholars.§该部门在为来访者及学者提供信息方面发挥着极其重要的作用。

22220§droplet§ˈdrɒplət§n. 小滴，微滴§Study of atmospheric particles formed from the explosion showed that droplets of sulphuric acid, acting as a screen between the Sun and the Earth's surface, caused a distinct drop in temperature.§对爆炸后形成的大气颗粒的研究显示，硫酸微粒在太阳与地球表面之间形成了一层屏障，使气温明显降低。
22221§reveal§rɪˈviːl§vt. 揭露；泄露；展现§The Human Genome Project will reveal a new human anatomy—the complete genetic blueprint for a human being.§人类基因工程将开启人类解剖学的新篇章——描绘完整的人类基因蓝图。
22222§visible§ˈvɪzəbl§adj. 可见的，看得见的；有形的；明显的，显而易见的§Comets are only normally visible in the immediate vicinity of the sun.§彗星只有在最接近太阳时才可见。
22223§conference§ˈkɒnfərəns§n. （正式）会议§I'm going to a conference in London.§我要去伦敦参加一个会议。
22224§cholesterol§kəˈlestərɒl§n. 胆固醇§Ostrich meat is much lower in fat and cholesterol than beef.§鸵鸟肉中的脂肪和胆固醇含量比牛肉中的低很多。
22225§calcium§ˈkælsiəm§n. 钙§Calcium is essential for developing healthy bones.§钙对骨骼的健康生长至关重要。
22226§construct§kənˈstrʌkt§vt. 建造；构思，构筑；创立[ˈkɒnstrʌkt] n. 构想，观念§This anticipation is constructed through films, TV and literature.§这一预想通过电影、电视和文学得以构思成形。
22227§interval§ˈɪntəvl§n. 间隔，幕间休息；间距§The discussion was so prolonged and exhausting that at intervals the speakers stopped for refreshment.§讨论冗长又使人疲倦，以至于发言人不时要停下来休息。
22228§advent§ˈædvent§n. 到来；出现§Sea ports have been transformed by the advent of powered vessels, whose size and draught have increased.§配有引擎的货船体积更加庞大，可以装载更多货物，它们的出现改变了海港原有的样子。
22229§aggressiveness§əˈɡresɪvnəs§n. 侵略；争斗；攻击§The message behind a crushing handshake is aggressiveness and a desire to compete.§在和他人握手时如果很用力，它传达的信息是争斗或想和对方竞争。
22230§category§ˈkætəgəri§n. 种类；类别；范畴§After the final interview, potential recruits were divided into three categories.§经过最后的面试，可能入选的新成员被分成三类。
22231§fault§fɔːlt§n. 缺点，瑕疵，毛病§Any fault should be reported to the local fault repair service.§出现任何问题都应报知当地的维修中心。
22232§confusion§kənˈfjuːʒn§n. 困惑，糊涂；混淆；混乱，杂乱，无秩序状态§This medicine may cause hair loss，depression or confusion, and yellowing of skin or eyes.§服用该药有可能导致脱发、精神抑郁或神志不清，还可能致使肤色或眼睛发黄。
22233§wrinkle§ˈrɪŋkl§n. 皱纹 v. （使）起皱纹§From where we are in the orchestra, you can see every wrinkle on her face.§从我们所在的剧院位置，你可以看到她脸上的每一条皱纹。
22234§huddle§ˈhʌdl§vi. 聚集在一起 n. 杂乱的一堆；拥挤§There is a huddle of people around the injured man.§一群人聚在伤者周围。

22235§clash§klæʃ§v. 发生冲突；打斗；不协调；砰地相撞，发出刺耳的撞击声n. 冲突；打斗；不协调；（金属等发出的）刺耳的撞击声§In the clash between environmentalists and developers, the Native Americans have suffered the most.§在环境保护主义者和开发者之间的冲突中，美洲原住民受到的伤害最大。
22236§briefly§ˈbriːfli§adv. 暂时地；简要地§He paused briefly before continuing.§他停了片刻又继续进行。
22237§commodity§kəˈmɒdəti§n. 商品，货物；日用品§Nowadays, the airlines are treating their seats like a commodity.§现在，航空公司把客机的席位看作是一种商品（进行出售）。
